cover_fields.explanatoryNotes: "Pzena Investment Management intended to vote in support of the Section 14A say-on-pay vote for the Skyworks Solutions Inc. annual meeting (May 13, 2026); however, due to an internal administrative processing delay, the ballot was transmitted past the tabulator cutoff and the 12,955,867 shares it was entitled to vote were recorded as unvoted by the issuer."
